title: MV Looking for a Victorian Tileset

posts.author: Creeperhead
posts.body: Hi, i'm kinda working on a game idea i refined for a long time. The Problem is, that there's barely anything Late gothic/Victorian in terms of assets that i was able to find. Does someone know a Victorian or at least Victorian inspired Tileset?

posts.author: Ariyana
posts.body: Kokoro Reflections have a Victorian-inspired mansion tileset: KR Victorian Mansion Tileset for RPGs

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:

What did you find?
Also some more context would be great, especially which makers you own since that might allow you to port resources and expand the pool of options.

Hi, i do own MV and MZ, but nothing else. The general idea is to make a little project that is heavily inspired by early victorian aesthetics with some mystery flair. I did find the train tileset DLC for MV with the characters that come with it as well as the Victorian Mansion one, but that's pretty much it.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Not sure if either of these from itch.io would be helpful to you or not. They might not blend with what you have already, but I thought I would share them just in case.
Having refreshed myself with the forum rules, I'm not sure if I can actually post links to a paid asset so I will just give you the titles and you should be able to find them yourself.
I went to itch.io and searched for "victorian tiles" and "victorian assets".
Manor: exterior Tileset for RPG MAKER MV/MZ (by houdini)​
Victorian Interior Upgraded (by nadia.pixel)
Christmas Ornaments (by nadia.pixel)
I hope these might be of some help.
